title: Bias A-head? Analyzing Bias in Transformer-Based Language Model Attention Heads

bias_targets.methodology: Gradient-based attention head bias estimation using Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) scores, counter-stereotype experiments measuring attention score changes when substituting gender attribute words, and log probabilities bias score (LPBS).

Gradient-based attention head bias estimation using Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) scores and counter-stereotype experiments measuring attention score changes when substituting racial attribute words (e.g., Caucasian vs. African American).
